headlines.title: 은퇴 후 月 1000만원 생활비, 고배당·성장주로 설계해야
headlines.summary: 돈 버는 법 아끼는 법 자산 대부분 부동산에 몰려 배당형 ETF·IRP 등 활용 땐 금융자산 불리고 복리효과도 은퇴 후엔 이자형 상품 추천 예측 가능한 현금흐름 장점 사진=게티이미지뱅크 Q. 서울 방배동에 거주하는 55세 직장인이다. 배우자는 전업주부고, 자녀는 올해 사회생활을 시작했다. 자산의 대부분이 집에 몰려 있다.

headlines.title: 전세 준 1주택 자 양도세 2배 뛸 수도 …‘ 세입자 밀어내기 ’ 현실화하나
headlines.summary: ■장특공제 축소 개편안 적용해보니 보유·거주기간 최대 40% 반영서 보유 비중 줄이고 거주 비중 확대 10년 보유·3년 거주자 기준으로 공제율 반토막…稅부담 크게 늘어 서울 시내 한 아파트 단지의 모습. 연합뉴스 이재명 대통령이 24일 장기보유특별공제 개편 방향에 대한 사실상의 가이드라인을 제시하면서 부동산 시장에서 파장이 예고되고 있다.

headlines.title: 李 "오래 투자했다고 양도세 깎아주면 투기 권장… 실거주 감면 은 필요"
headlines.summary: [앵커] 이재명 대통령이 장기보유 특별공제 제도에 대해 또 한 번 강하게 비판했습니다. '주택 투기 권장정책'이라고까지 표현을 했는데요. 그러면서도 실거주 기간 양도세 감면은 필요하다고 강조했습니다. 자세히 알아봅니다.

headlines.title: 유가 나흘째 급등 105달러 … 국내 경유 2000원 넘어
headlines.summary: 美-이란 휴전 이전 수준으로 복귀 서울의 한 주유소에 기름 가격이 적혀 있다. 뉴스1 호르무즈 해협에서 미국과 이란의 군사적 긴장감이 높아지면서 국제 유가가 다시 오름세를 보이고 있다. 중동 리스크가 재부각되면서 글로벌 원유 시장이 ‘휴전 이전’ 수준으로 되돌아가는 분위기다.

headlines.title: 석유 최고가격의 그림자 …주유소 83곳 2주째 휴업
headlines.summary: 가격통제 장기화 영세업체 직격탄 2주 이상 장기휴업 70%가 읍면 소재 1억~2억 달하는 폐업비용도 부담…휴업 외 대안 없어 24일 서울의 한 주유소 모습의 휘발유 가격이 2300원에 육박하고 있다. 연합뉴스 최근 2주간 전국에서 최소 83곳의 주유소가 사실상 휴업 상태에 빠진 것으로 나타났다.

headlines.title: “ 대출 받아 기름 탱크 채워야 할 판 ”… 출구 막힌 최고가격제
headlines.summary: [주유소 83곳 2주째 휴업] 정부 고강도 압박에 가격 못올려 15년 영업하던 곳도 보름전 문닫아 공급은 줄었는데 재정으로 억눌러 시장 왜곡에 수급 꼬임도 만만찮아 전문가 “시점 정해 과감히 중단해야” 경유가격은 4년만에 2000원 넘어 16일 충남 부여군의 한 주유소. ‘휴업 중’이라는 안내판이 놓여 있다.

sections.Hot Economy News: Deputy Prime Minister Koo Yun-chul made high-profile visits to promote domestic consumption and small business recovery, visiting the Busan Walking Festival and meeting with major corporate leaders. He emphasized government commitment to improving business conditions and stimulating regional economies while encouraging companies to innovate and develop next-generation industries beyond semiconductors. The government is actively signaling support for both small enterprises and major corporations as it aims to revitalize domestic demand amid global economic uncertainties.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: Korea's potential growth rate concerns have intensified as demographic and fiscal pressures mount, with experts warning of structural economic challenges ahead. International institutions are revising growth outlooks, with BNP Paribas raising Korea's 2026 forecast to 2.7% while suggesting the Bank of Korea may consider earlier rate increases if energy shocks persist. Japan's central bank is expected to maintain its benchmark rate at an upcoming policy meeting while downwardly revising growth projections due to Middle East-related oil price increases. Taiwan's economic growth outlook has been dramatically upgraded to 7.56% for 2026, significantly higher than previous forecasts, driven primarily by strong AI-related demand.
sections.Financial Markets: South Korea's stock market reached a historic milestone, surpassing 6 trillion won in total market capitalization for the first time, with KOSPI briefly exceeding 6,600 points. Foreign investors are actively purchasing both Korean stocks and government bonds, creating downward pressure on the won amid favorable market sentiment. However, concerns are emerging about excessive ETF concentration in certain sectors, with semiconductor-related ETFs holding approximately 20% of small and mid-sized materials companies' market value. The upcoming U.S. Federal Reserve meeting is expected to result in a rate hold, with market probability at 100%, though all eyes remain on Chairman Powell's final policy statement.
sections.Industry & Technology: Chinese electric vehicle manufacturers, led by BYD, are increasingly exporting and expanding globally, prompting European premium brands like Mercedes-Benz and BMW to adopt Chinese battery technology. South Korea's battery and semiconductor industries are responding with innovation, including LG Energy Solution's dry-process battery technology aimed at reducing costs while maintaining performance. Korean semiconductor companies are expanding into adjacent markets, with BOS Semiconductor developing automotive chips for robotics and AI applications. Construction companies are integrating AI and digital technologies, with IPARK achieving 48% operating profit growth through innovations like digital twin technology and AI-based voice recognition systems.
sections.Real Estate: High-priced apartment complexes in Busan experienced explosive trading activity following the lifting of resale restrictions, despite ongoing oversupply concerns in the region. Cheongsae (lease) inventory has significantly declined in Seoul, prompting renters to shift toward home purchases, with purchase activity doubling in certain regions. April's apartment subscription market shows favorable momentum with 3,559 units from 11 locations receiving subscription applications nationwide, particularly driven by price-capped developments in the Seoul metropolitan area. New apartment supply in Gyeonggi Province includes competitive pricing around 22.5 million won per pyeong and special features like wide terraces and high ceilings.
sections.International Economy: The U.S. Federal Reserve is expected to hold its benchmark interest rate steady at the April FOMC meeting, with market probability at 100%, marking what may be Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell's final policy meeting before his May 15 term expiration. Markets have shifted focus away from rate cut expectations as geopolitical tensions and energy concerns weigh on economic forecasts. Japan's central bank is projected to maintain its policy rate while downwardly revising growth estimates due to elevated oil prices from Middle East instability. Global investors are monitoring key U.S. economic data and geopolitical developments, including unfolding security concerns that could affect market sentiment.
sections.AI & Economy: Korean researchers have advanced AI-based pharmaceutical development by overcoming a major technical barrier: maintaining both binding efficacy and production efficiency in AI-designed antibodies simultaneously. IPARK's strong first-quarter earnings, with operating profit up 48% year-over-year, reflect the construction industry's growing adoption of AI technologies including digital twins and AI-powered voice recognition systems. The integration of generative AI in smart home features and construction process management is becoming a competitive advantage for major developers. These developments demonstrate AI's expanding economic impact across multiple sectors beyond traditional technology companies.
sections.Others: Bitcoin recovered above $79,000 for the first time in 83 days, indicating renewed investor appetite for digital assets despite recent Middle East conflict uncertainties. Auto insurance companies are introducing new incentive products offering 2% annual premium discounts for drivers participating in the vehicle odd-even scheme, effective retroactively from April 1st. Hyundai Motor's executive emphasized the company's successful adaptation to market challenges through hybrid vehicle offerings and plans for renewed growth in China through intelligent and eco-friendly vehicle development. Domestic researchers achieved a breakthrough in AI antibody drug development, demonstrating the practical effectiveness of AI-based pharmaceutical design while overcoming traditional engineering limitations.
